messages:
deploybot: [AUTOMATED] Rollout paused for rc-2026.03.11 due to INC-2026-041 (auth 502 spike in eu-west-1). Canaries aborted; hold applied.

sara: noticed. canary was ~5%. did it affect core traffic?

jamal: only eu canaries. us-east unaffected.

alex: recommendation: pin eu control-plane to v3.4.1 and requeue later. no DB migrations in this RC.

morgan_ops: ops prefers pin+requeue to reduce blast radius. if rollback needed we'll throttle DB connections.

priya_pm: drafting comms: "Pausing today's rollout due to authentication instability in EU regions. Reverting canaries and rescheduling during a quiet window." add "no customer data at risk"?

jamal: add that line.

priya_pm: updated and will send to comms after rollback confirmation.

alex: executing rollback: `deploybot rollback --to v3.4.1 --services auth,web --reason INC-2026-041`. Will attach rollback SHA.

oncall-bot: @morgan_ops acknowledged. Incident tagged `release-hold`. Deploy alerts suppressed.

alex: rollback complete. rollback-gitsha: a1b2c3d. health checks show 200s in eu at 03:12 UTC.

morgan_ops: verified steady 200s. leaving manual hold until infra does quick RCA. proposing reschedule window 2026-03-12 03:00-05:00 UTC.

sara: follow-ups: assign postmortem owner, re-run dry-run on canary infra, add auth circuit check to release checklist.

jamal: assigned: priya->comms, alex->rollback notes+sha, morgan_ops->ops verification, sara->checklist.

oncall-bot: INC-2026-041 status=mitigated, hold_state=manual_hold, next_window_proposal=2026-03-12T03:00:00Z.

alex: moved RC to staged-requeue and tagged `needs-auth-fix` so it won't auto-retry.

morgan_ops: ops will smoke test for 30m in the proposed window and lift hold if stable. :hourglass:
